description: This file defines functions for converting HTTP/2 protocol constants and enums to string representations, including frame types, flags, error codes, and settings parameters. It also manages invalid header names for HTTP/2.

methods.name: Http2FrameTypeToString
methods.description: Converts an Http2FrameType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: Http2FrameTypeToString (uint8_t)
methods.description: Converts a uint8_t value to the corresponding Http2FrameType string.

methods.name: Http2FrameFlagsToString
methods.description: Converts frame type and flags to a human-readable string.

methods.name: Http2FrameFlagsToString (uint8_t, uint8_t)
methods.description: Converts type and flags bytes to a string.

methods.name: Http2ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts an error code to its string representation.

methods.name: Http2ErrorCodeToString (Http2ErrorCode)
methods.description: Overload that converts Http2ErrorCode enum to string.

methods.name: Http2SettingsParameterToString
methods.description: Converts a settings parameter value to string.

methods.name: GetInvalidHttp2HeaderSet
methods.description: Returns a set of invalid HTTP/2 header names based on configuration flags.
